name: Plex
description: Search/execute over the Plex Media Server HTTP API, catalog from the pinned community OpenAPI spec.

baseUrl.help: The address of the Plex Media Server itself, usually on port 32400, not app.plex.tv.

token.help: An X-Plex-Token with access to this server. Sent as the X-Plex-Token header.

specBaseUrl.help: Leave empty to fetch the API spec from GitHub. Set a mirror whose layout is <url>/<git commit>/plex-api-spec.yaml if this server can't reach GitHub.

connection.help:
1. Get a token for an account with access to this server: in Plex Web, open any item → **⋯ → Get Info → View XML**; the URL ends with `X-Plex-Token=…`. The server owner's token has full control of the server.
2. Enter the server address (e.g. `http://192.168.1.10:32400`) and the token, then **Test connection**.
3. Keep *Verify TLS* on unless the server uses a self-signed certificate on a trusted network.

Plex Media Server doesn't serve an API spec, so the catalog comes from the community spec (`LukeHagar/plex-api-spec`) at a commit pinned in this plugin. Only operations the server itself answers are included; plex.tv account and sharing APIs are not. No credentials are sent to GitHub.
